title: Scripted buyer-agent simulator
context: Needed for both integration testing and the live demo. Must be fully scripted/deterministic — no live LLM calls during the demo's critical path, per PRD risk mitigation.
objective: Build a standalone Python script that walks: discover catalog -> create session -> update session -> complete session, hitting your real API.
scope_in: buyer_agent_sim.py as a standalone script, no framework dependency beyond requests/httpx
Clear console output at each step showing request and response
Configurable target base URL (localhost or deployed)
scope_out: No natural language / LLM reasoning — this is a scripted API walker, not an AI agent
acceptance_criteria: Running python buyer_agent_sim.py against a locally running backend completes all 4 steps without manual intervention
Script exits non-zero and prints a clear message if any step fails
Output is readable enough to screen-record directly for the pitch video
